Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)
Class: Poor Quality Crossbow
Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Supercharger, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Can't load ammo that deals no damage (Arrowhypo, Sleep, etc.) or delivers poison (Biotoxin, Poison, etc.). Charging its Tech Rebuild costs only half your MOVE (rounded down), paid before you move that Turn (Supercharger). Without BODY 11+ or paired Cyberarms, the wielder takes -1 DEX and MOVE. Clearing a jam takes 2 Actions.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
